'''Zsinj's father''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. Near the end of the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he and a human female from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] named [[Maarisa Zsinj]] produced a male child, [[Zsinj]], who would eventually become one of the most powerful [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] in the history of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], Zsinj's father was a simple [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] by trade. He fathered a child with [[Maarisa Zsinj]], a human female from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and in the tradition of his [[Fondorian]] caste, their offspring bore a single name: [[Zsinj]].<ref name="IW1" /> Zsinj's father passed on some of his aptitude for engineering to his son,<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> but Zsinj eventually took after his mother and enrolled in the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt IV naval academy]].<ref name="IW1" />

Although Maarisa Zsinj went on to become a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], and the younger Zsinj became a [[Warlord of the Empire]] for hunting her down,<ref name="IW1" /> multiple historical records make no further mention of Zsinj's father except in terms of his relationship to his infamous family.<ref name="CTD" /><ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
